svg.title: Proa, Marko, React and SvelteKit streaming the product grid under HTTP load
svg.desc: Proa and SvelteKit captured 2026-10-21 UTC; Marko and React captured September 4, 2026. One worker thread or process per engine. SvelteKit response end delivers promised data and excludes browser rendering; the other streams deliver resolved HTML. svg.text: 96 cards · 8 boundaries · one worker/process per engine · medians of 3 processes
Higher is better · dashed: request-rate target
Proa/SvelteKit: 2026-10-21 UTC. Marko/React: September 4, 2026. Same host, fixture and offered rates.
SvelteKit response end delivers data; the others deliver resolved HTML. Browser completion: sveltekit/browser.svg.
Successful-response latency includes scheduled queueing. Failures by rate remain in the source tables.
